description: This file implements a front panel control module for a media device, including LED brightness, power state, blinking patterns, and indicator management. It interacts with hardware indicators and power management interfaces, and contains class and method definitions related to front panel operations.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, brightness, blinking patterns, and power state interactions.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern details for LEDs.

classes.name: FrontPanelBlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information for individual blink steps, including color, brightness, and duration.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes hardware and power interfaces.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and resets singleton instance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts front panel indicator control, initializes indicator states.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timers and indicator updates.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the current power status of the device.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel LEDs.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified LED indicators.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off specified LED indicators.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all indicators.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all indicators.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Configures LED color and brightness based on parameters.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for LEDs.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Starts blinking timer with specified repeat count.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking timer.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED to a specific blink pattern step.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for blinking timer to update LED state.
